mapper.sql: cs.id AS id, cs.code AS code, cs.case_title AS caseTitle, cs.summary AS summary, csd.crm_support_pipeline_setting_id AS pipelineId, csps.description AS pipelineName, csd.crm_support_stag_id AS stageId, css.name AS stageName, csd.probability AS probability, csps.type_id AS typeId, CASE csps.type_id WHEN 1 THEN 'Internal' WHEN 2 THEN 'External' END AS typeName, cs.customer_id AS organizationId, customers.name AS organizationName, cs.priority_id AS priorityId, hr_todo_list_priorities.name AS priorityName, cs.assigned_to AS assignedTo, CONCAT(assigned.first_name, ' ', assigned.last_name) AS assignedToName, cs.customer_contact_id AS contactId, customer_contacts.contact_name AS contactName, cs.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, cs.modified AS modified, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM crm_supports AS cs LEFT JOIN crm_support_details AS csd ON csd.crm_support_id = cs.id AND csd.is_active = 1 AND csd.is_convert = 0 LEFT JOIN crm_support_pipeline_settings AS csps ON csps.id = csd.crm_support_pipeline_setting_id LEFT JOIN crm_support_stags AS css ON css.id = csd.crm_support_stag_id LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = cs.customer_id LEFT JOIN customer_contacts ON customer_contacts.id = cs.customer_contact_id LEFT JOIN hr_todo_list_priorities ON hr_todo_list_priorities.id = cs.priority_id LEFT JOIN users AS assigned ON assigned.id = cs.assigned_to LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = cs.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = cs.modified_by
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_supports SET case_title = #{support.caseTitle}, summary = #{support.summary}, priority_id = #{support.priorityId}, customer_id = #{support.customerId}, customer_contact_id = #{support.customerContactId}, assigned_to = #{support.assignedTo}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{support.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{support.id} AND is_active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_support_details ( crm_support_id, crm_support_pipeline_setting_id, crm_support_stag_id, probability, created, created_by, is_active, is_convert ) VALUES ( #{detail.supportId}, #{detail.pipelineId}, #{detail.stageId}, #{detail.probability}, NOW(), #{detail.createdBy}, #{detail.isActive}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT percent FROM crm_support_pipeline_setting_stags WHERE crm_support_stag_id = #{stageId} ORDER BY ordering ASC LIMIT 1
